summary: The top 150 HRAiN/TRUMP mechanics candidates from the full-current Meta Registry ranking were re-read from one frozen source commit, translated into a canonical PCNER_GPEI obligation schema, checked for required universal assumptions, and attacked with generic complexity counterexamples. Two artifacts survived this finite audit as conditional route formulations only. No theorem or SAT-in-P promotion occurred.

canonical_pcner_gpei_translation.POLY_FIND: For every reachable nonterminal state, one frozen algorithm must discover/recognize a canonical exact useful action in polynomial total work measured against original N.
canonical_pcner_gpei_translation.POLY_HOLD: All reachable state, representation, auxiliary, certificate and deferred-debt liability must remain in one fixed original-N polynomial envelope.
canonical_pcner_gpei_translation.POLY_ADVANCE: Every committed step must preserve exact decision semantics, make strict well-founded progress, and have polynomially bounded normalization/microsteps and macrostep count.
canonical_pcner_gpei_translation.EXACTNESS_CERTIFICATION: Every transition must have independently replayable exact verification with certificate bytes and verifier work charged polynomially in original N.
canonical_pcner_gpei_translation.DEBT_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING: Failed discovery, representation growth, deferred work, proof bytes, verification, recovery, switching and normalization are never free.
canonical_pcner_gpei_translation.PCNER_GPEI: POLY_FIND AND POLY_HOLD AND POLY_ADVANCE AND EXACTNESS_CERTIFICATION AND DEBT_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING under one frozen deterministic arbitrary-CNF algorithm.

conditional_survivors.meaning: This artifact states the full obligation surface strongly enough to survive the frozen assumption/attack checklist. It does not prove the universal obligation itself.
This artifact also spans the complete obligation surface and correctly leaves universal GPEI preservation OPEN. Survival is formulation coherence, not a proof.

interpretation.strongest_result: The 150-candidate surface collapsed to two coherent conditional PCNER_GPEI formulations under the frozen checklist; 148 candidates exposed either scope or assumption gaps under generic attacks.
interpretation.what_this_does_not_mean: The two survivors are not algorithms, not universal preservation proofs, and not evidence that SAT is in P. They are the two registry objects that currently state the necessary obligation structure most completely.
interpretation.next_gate: SURVIVOR_TO_EXECUTABLE_OBLIGATION_MATRIX: split each survivor into independently falsifiable lemmas for FIND, HOLD, ADVANCE, EXACTNESS and DEBT; bind each lemma to an executable witness/counterfamily and require a proof-carrying receipt before any composition claim.
interpretation.priority: Do not broaden search again before attacking the two survivors lemma-by-lemma.
